rawRecord.name: DBTrail
rawRecord.short_description: Track MySQL database changes with row-level recovery, forensic attribution, and compliance reporting.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: DBTrail provides continuous change tracking for MySQL databases, recording every insert, update, and delete operation with user attribution and timestamps. It enables row-level point-in-time recovery, allowing instant undo of specific changes without full database restoration. AI assistants can query change history and trigger targeted recoveries using natural language through the MCP integration.
